scope: Sweep allocations reached while dx_iface validates and emits a bounded nested-dictionary graph containing two typed DICTIONARYVAR records, checking whole-output rollback and same-adapter retry.

method.calibration: For each output encoding, import the generated source and perform one successful export with a high allocation countdown armed at entry to dx_iface::writeObjects; compute reached allocations from the remaining countdown.

method.retry: Disable injection and export with the same adapter and source model; inspect the emitted dictionary/DICTIONARYVAR wire and fresh-import the output to verify nested ownership and both typed values.
